ai_review.summary: Upgrade offers a much clearer Dark Star but the original source still suffers from over‑driven piano/vocals, especially in the first set.
ai_review.review: The new seed is praised as the best version available, delivering a flawless Dark Star and overall improvement over previous releases. However, reviewers note that the original recording was plagued by muddy, over‑driven piano and vocal sections early in the show, keeping the audio quality from being truly pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is widely regarded as a classic (high musical value) while recording quality is mixed – notable improvements but lingering source flaws; weighted average yields ~4.0‑4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original source has over‑driven piano and vocal sections, especially in the first set; this seed mitigates many issues but some distortion remains.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not detailed in reviews; overall show is considered a classic by fans.
